source.book: 《史记》卷一百一十九《循吏列传》
source.excerpt: 客有遺相魚者，相不受。客曰：「聞君嗜魚，遺君魚，何故不受也？」相曰：「以嗜魚，故不受也。今爲相，能自給魚；今受魚而免，誰復給我魚者？吾故不受也。」
source.transcriptionNote: 复用现有已录入批次的逐字原文快照；底本定位、原件哈希及行号保留。电子本尚不宣称纸本异文全校。

panels.title: 鱼送上门
panels.caption: 一位客人带着鱼，来到公仪休家。
panels.scene: Wide scene at a modest ancient residence: visitor in ochre carries a tray with one fish; teal-robed Gongyi Xiu receives him at the doorway.

panels.title: 摆手谢绝
panels.caption: 公仪休看见鱼，却摆手谢绝。
panels.scene: Medium close view: Gongyi Xiu gently raises his empty hand in refusal; visitor still holds the fish tray.

panels.title: 客人的疑问
panels.caption: 客人很不解：“听说您爱吃鱼，为什么送来了，反倒不收？”
panels.scene: Visitor looks puzzled and points toward his own fish tray while Gongyi Xiu listens.

evidence.excerpt: 聞君嗜魚，遺君魚，何故不受也？

panels.title: 正因为爱吃
panels.caption: 公仪休说：“正因为爱吃鱼，我才不能收。”
panels.scene: Close portrait of calm Gongyi Xiu explaining with a slight smile; the surprised visitor appears at the edge. Fish stays with visitor.

panels.title: 想得更远
panels.caption: “如今我担任相，自己有能力买鱼。假如收礼丢了官，谁还会给我鱼呢？”
panels.scene: Two men face each other across the threshold. Gongyi Xiu speaks thoughtfully with empty palms; visitor lowers the tray and listens. This is a conversation, NOT an actual dismissal from office.

evidence.excerpt: 今爲相，能自給魚；今受魚而免，誰復給我魚者？

panels.title: 这鱼不收
panels.caption: 他没有收下这条鱼。爱吃的东西，也不必用收礼来得到。
panels.scene: Final medium-wide scene: Gongyi Xiu stands composed at the doorway; visitor holds the same fish tray, now understanding. No fish or gift has changed hands.

generation.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: a finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua story atlas, exactly 6 sequential illustrations on ONE image. Primary request: 公仪休拒鱼. Composition: STRICT equal rectangular grid of TWO columns and 3 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. All row heights equal, all column widths equal. Canvas target 1024 x 960. Narrow straight cream gutters, maximum 4 pixels; no outer margin, no header/footer; every scene fills its own complete LANDSCAPE cell. No merged panels, insets, or changes in layout.
Style: classic 1950s-1960s Chinese small-picture storybook, early Shanghai Animation folk-art sensibility. Graceful expressive fine ink outlines, hand-painted gouache, mineral blue/green, muted cinnabar and ochre, textured warm cream paper, restrained humor and human facial expressions. Rich but legible environments; varied wide/medium/close shots. NOT modern anime, 3D, glossy or photorealistic. Ancient China, no modern objects. No words, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons, calligraphy, watermark or symbols that look like writing ANYWHERE. Clothing and face continuity within the atlas is essential.
Characters and invariants: Gongyi Xiu: middle-aged scholarly man, narrow beard, teal robe and simple dark formal cap. Visitor: round face, ochre robe, cloth headwrap. Only the visitor holds a fish on a small wooden tray. Gongyi Xiu NEVER accepts the gift. No modern fish market packaging.
Scenes in this exact order:
1. Wide scene at a modest ancient residence: visitor in ochre carries a tray with one fish; teal-robed Gongyi Xiu receives him at the doorway.
2. Medium close view: Gongyi Xiu gently raises his empty hand in refusal; visitor still holds the fish tray.
3. Visitor looks puzzled and points toward his own fish tray while Gongyi Xiu listens.
4. Close portrait of calm Gongyi Xiu explaining with a slight smile; the surprised visitor appears at the edge. Fish stays with visitor.
5. Two men face each other across the threshold. Gongyi Xiu speaks thoughtfully with empty palms; visitor lowers the tray and listens. This is a conversation, NOT an actual dismissal from office.
6. Final medium-wide scene: Gongyi Xiu stands composed at the doorway; visitor holds the same fish tray, now understanding. No fish or gift has changed hands.

styleRefinement.mode: image_gen style-transfer using actual reference images
styleRefinement.instructions: Use case: style-transfer. Restyle ONLY IMAGE 1, the edit target. IMAGE 2 (approved older 移木立信 artwork) is the PRIMARY style reference; IMAGE 3 (newly corrected fish-refusal artwork) is a SECONDARY reference for the same approved style. Do not import reference story events, characters, sword/pole/fish props, captions or text. Draw the target in the same artistic language as images 2 and 3: strongly designed Chinese folk/early Shanghai animation characters, larger expressive heads, compact stylized adult bodies, angular expressive eyebrows and noses made with very few confident strokes, small curved eyes, humorous expressive poses, fluid varied BLACK ink contours, FLAT matte pigment blocks with only spare broad ink-wash texture. Reduce realistic anatomy, skin modeling, facial shading, brocade patterns, tiny clothing folds and detailed background rendering dramatically. Robes are mostly solid muted color fields with spare trim, NO all-over elaborate embroidery. Simplify background buildings into rhythmic geometric silhouettes, light ink washes and warm UNPAINTED cream space. Restrained indigo, ochre and cinnabar, subtle paper grain like image 2, no dense brown texture overlay. NOT realistic illustrated portraiture, glossy painting, modern anime, chibi toys, 3D or photorealism. Keep all characters ADULT unless explicitly elderly. Preserve each character's consistent identifying robe color, beard and role, but redraw their form in this stylized way. No words, numerals, letters, title, captions, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermark or readable marks ANYWHERE, including on documents, garments or props. Ignore all text visible in the style reference. Do not add a header or footer.
styleRefinement.prompt: 使用原图为编辑目标，以旧徙木立信、守株待兔成图为直接风格参考；夸张人物造型、简练黑线、平涂色块，保留六格情节和拒鱼结果。

previousAfterword.title: 喜欢与取舍
paragraphs: 《史记·循吏列传》记下这段问答。公仪休没有否认自己的喜好，而是说明：收下眼前的好处，可能损失长久的自给能力。
丢官是他用来解释拒礼的假设，并非这次故事中已经发生的事。

takeaway.title: 想要长久拥有，也要懂得拒绝
takeaway.text: 知道自己喜欢什么，也要想清楚怎样得到它。

previousAfterword.sourceNote: 据《史记》卷一百一十九《循吏列传》改编。对白为现代白话改写，人物外貌、动作细节和现场构图为艺术表现。
